caveat: Isolated only if the header's own locator rules read P as S × m, as Section 9.1 defines it. A Reader that reads P from 0x50 finds H + P = 4 ≠ 5 as well, with the same name. With a readable footer no isolation is possible: the footer's P either disagrees with 0x50 or, mirrored as 3, breaks the footer's own tail = H + P.
every_other_rule_holds: Section 9.1 defines P = S × m = 4, and with that P the header's tail start 5 = H + P, footer index 6 = 2H + P and total 7 = 2H + P + 1 hold, matching the 7-block file. The index still has S*m = 4 parity entries (Section 9.3). The copies agree with each other. The footer is unreadable, so its P = 4 is compared with nothing. Directory key 7 is not compared with the header (Section 13.3 agreement set).
integrity_repair: ISO-BOTH (new hash in both copies and directory key 8; directory key 7 stays 4)
quotes: `P = S × m` is the parity shard block count
